typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	toKriKpiTotalActivity_outputfilename as string (),
	startTime as string ()
}

source(output(
		INVENTORY_NAME as string,
		TRADING_UNIT_NAME as string,
		DESK_NAME as string,
		DESK_MANAGER_NAME as string,
		wells_Entity_Name as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FromtblIMGENERICALLSTATUS	source(output(
		TRADE_ID as decimal(38,0),
		TRADE_DATE_TIME as timestamp,
		PRODUCT_FAMILY as string,
		PRODUCT_TYPE as string,
		PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE as string,
		SHORT_NAME as string,
		LONG_NAME as string,
		INTERNAL as string,
		SALES_PERSON as string,
		TRADE_STATUS as string,
		TRADER_NAME as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FromCalypso	source(output(
		TRADE_ID as decimal(38,0),
		TRADE_COUNTERPARTY as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FromCAlypsoCptyType	source(output(
		USER_NAME as string,
		ADENT as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FromCalyspousername	source(output(
		Calypso_Reference as string,
		Book_Name as string,
		Trade_Status as string,
		Business_Date_Rpt as timestamp,
		User_Nme as string,
		Business_Month as timestamp,
		new_modif_date as timestamp,
		EconomicChange_Exist as string,
		TrueAmendment as string,
		TrueCancelCorrect as string,
		GaapRelief_Exist as string,
		Lifecycle as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FromOTCTradeAudit	source(output(
		TRADE_ID as string,
		MODIF_DATE as timestamp,
		LifeCycle as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
FromCAlypsoCptyType sort(asc(TRADE_ID, false)) ~> SortTradeIDCalypso
FromOTCTradeAudit aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
FromOTCTradeAudit,LookupLKPTABLE lookup(new_modif_date == MODIF_DATE && FromOTCTradeAudit@Lifecycle == LookupLKPTABLE@LifeCycle && Calypso_Reference == TRADE_ID,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
Lookup filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 derive(oCalypso_Reference = toInteger(Calypso_Reference)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sort(asc(oCalypso_Reference, false)) ~> SortTradeId
SortTradeId,FromCalypso join(oCalypso_Reference == TRADE_ID,
	joinType:'left',
	broadcast: 'none')~> GetCalypsoFields
GetCalypsoFields derive(Book_Name = Book_Name,
		Trade_Status = Trade_Status,
		Business_Date_Rpt = Business_Date_Rpt,
		oCalypso_Reference = oCalypso_Reference,
		TRADE_DATE_TIME = TRADE_DATE_TIME,
		PRODUCT_FAMILY = PRODUCT_FAMILY,
		PRODUCT_TYPE = PRODUCT_TYPE,
		PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE = PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE,
		SHORT_NAME = SHORT_NAME,
		LONG_NAME = LONG_NAME,
		INTERNAL = INTERNAL,
		TRADE_STATUS = TRADE_STATUS,
		TRADER_NAME = TRADER_NAME,
		SALES_PERSON = SALES_PERSON,
		User_Nme = User_Nme,
		Business_Month = Business_Month,
		new_modif_date = new_modif_date,
		EconomicChange_Exist = EconomicChange_Exist,
		TrueAmendment = TrueAmendment,
		TrueCancelCorrect = TrueCancelCorrect,
		GaapRelief_Exist = GaapRelief_Exist) ~> GetCalypsoFields0
GetCalypsoFields0 sort(asc(Book_Name, false)) ~> SortBookName
SortBookName,FromtblIMGENERICALLSTATUS join(Book_Name == INVENTORY_NAME,
	joinType:'left',
	broadcast: 'none')~> MergeTradeandInvMaster
MergeTradeandInvMaster derive(PRODUCT_FAMILY = PRODUCT_FAMILY,
		PRODUCT_TYPE = PRODUCT_TYPE,
		PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE = PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE,
		SHORT_NAME = SHORT_NAME,
		LONG_NAME = LONG_NAME,
		INTERNAL = INTERNAL,
		Book_Name = Book_Name,
		Business_Date_Rpt = Business_Date_Rpt,
		oCalypso_Reference = oCalypso_Reference,
		TRADING_UNIT_NAME = TRADING_UNIT_NAME,
		DESK_NAME = DESK_NAME,
		DESK_MANAGER_NAME = DESK_MANAGER_NAME,
		wells_Entity_Name = wells_Entity_Name,
		Trade_Status = Trade_Status,
		TRADE_DATE_TIME = TRADE_DATE_TIME,
		TRADE_STATUS = TRADE_STATUS,
		TRADER_NAME = TRADER_NAME,
		SALES_PERSON = SALES_PERSON,
		User_Nme = User_Nme,
		Business_Month = Business_Month,
		new_modif_date = new_modif_date,
		EconomicChange_Exist = EconomicChange_Exist,
		TrueAmendment = TrueAmendment,
		TrueCancelCorrect = TrueCancelCorrect,
		GaapRelief_Exist = GaapRelief_Exist) ~> MergeTradeandInvMaster0
MergeTradeandInvMaster0 derive(sWellsEntityName = toString((iif(isNull(wells_Entity_Name), 'NOT FOUND IN INV MASTER', wells_Entity_Name))),
		sDeskName = toString((iif(isNull(DESK_NAME), 'NOT FOUND IN INV MASTER', DESK_NAME)))) ~> AssignnullInvMaster
AssignnullInvMaster sort(asc(User_Nme, false)) ~> Sortusername
Sortusername,FromCalyspousername join(User_Nme == USER_NAME,
	joinType:'left',
	broadcast: 'none')~> mergeusernameADENT
mergeusernameADENT derive(PRODUCT_FAMILY = PRODUCT_FAMILY,
		PRODUCT_TYPE = PRODUCT_TYPE,
		PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE = PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE,
		SHORT_NAME = SHORT_NAME,
		LONG_NAME = LONG_NAME,
		INTERNAL = INTERNAL,
		Book_Name = Book_Name,
		Business_Date_Rpt = Business_Date_Rpt,
		oCalypso_Reference = oCalypso_Reference,
		TRADING_UNIT_NAME = TRADING_UNIT_NAME,
		DESK_MANAGER_NAME = DESK_MANAGER_NAME,
		sWellsEntityName = sWellsEntityName,
		sDeskName = sDeskName,
		ADENT = ADENT,
		Trade_Status = Trade_Status,
		TRADE_DATE_TIME = TRADE_DATE_TIME,
		TRADE_STATUS = TRADE_STATUS,
		TRADER_NAME = TRADER_NAME,
		User_Nme = User_Nme,
		Business_Month = Business_Month,
		new_modif_date = new_modif_date,
		SALES_PERSON = SALES_PERSON,
		EconomicChange_Exist = EconomicChange_Exist,
		TrueAmendment = TrueAmendment,
		TrueCancelCorrect = TrueCancelCorrect,
		GaapRelief_Exist = GaapRelief_Exist) ~> mergeusernameADENT0
mergeusernameADENT0 sort(asc(oCalypso_Reference, false)) ~> SorttradeID0
SorttradeID0,SortTradeIDCalypso join(oCalypso_Reference == TRADE_ID,
	joinType:'left',
	broadcast: 'none')~> MergeJoin
MergeJoin derive(PRODUCT_FAMILY = PRODUCT_FAMILY,
		PRODUCT_TYPE = PRODUCT_TYPE,
		PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE = PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE,
		SHORT_NAME = SHORT_NAME,
		LONG_NAME = LONG_NAME,
		INTERNAL = INTERNAL,
		Book_Name = Book_Name,
		Business_Date_Rpt = Business_Date_Rpt,
		oCalypso_Reference = oCalypso_Reference,
		TRADING_UNIT_NAME = TRADING_UNIT_NAME,
		DESK_MANAGER_NAME = DESK_MANAGER_NAME,
		sWellsEntityName = sWellsEntityName,
		sDeskName = sDeskName,
		ADENT = ADENT,
		Trade_Status = Trade_Status,
		TRADE_DATE_TIME = TRADE_DATE_TIME,
		TRADE_STATUS = TRADE_STATUS,
		TRADER_NAME = TRADER_NAME,
		User_Nme = User_Nme,
		Business_Month = Business_Month,
		new_modif_date = new_modif_date,
		TRADE_COUNTERPARTY = TRADE_COUNTERPARTY,
		SALES_PERSON = SALES_PERSON,
		GaapRelief_Exist = GaapRelief_Exist,
		TrueCancelCorrect = TrueCancelCorrect,
		TrueAmendment = TrueAmendment,
		EconomicChange_Exist = EconomicChange_Exist) ~> MergeJoin0
MergeJoin0 derive(sLifecycle = toString('Amendment'),
		dCreateDate = toString($startTime)) ~> AddLifecycle
AddLifecycle derive(oPRODUCT_SUB_TYPE = PRODUCT_SUB_TYPE,
		oUser_Nme = User_Nme,
		oPRODUCT_TYPE = PRODUCT_TYPE,
		{o TRADING_UNIT_NAME} = TRADING_UNIT_NAME,
		oTRADER_NAME = TRADER_NAME,
		oSALES_PERSON = SALES_PERSON,
		oSHORT_NAME = SHORT_NAME,
		oLONG_NAME = LONG_NAME,
		oTrade_Status = Trade_Status,
		oTRADE_COUNTERPARTY = TRADE_COUNTERPARTY,
		{o INTERNAL} = INTERNAL,
		oDESK_MANAGER_NAME = DESK_MANAGER_NAME) ~> DataConversiontoKri
DataConversiontoKri sink(input(
		LifeCycle as string,
		Create_Dte as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		COUNTERPARTY_NAME as string,
		COUNTERPARTY_TYPE as string,
		TRADER_NAME as string,
		Internal as string,
		TrueAmendment as string,
		TrueCancelCorrect as string,
		GaapRelief_Exist as string,
		BOOK_NAME as string,
		USER_NAME as string,
		CHANGE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		TRADE_STATUS as string,
		DESK_NAME as string,
		COUNTERPARTY_LONGNAME as string,
		PRODUCT_TYPE as string,
		MODIF_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		SALES_PERSON as string,
		TRADING_UNIT_NAME as string,
		EconomicChange_Exist as string,
		TRADE_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,batchSize: 100,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		LifeCycle = sLifecycle,
		Create_Dte = dCreateDate,
		COUNTERPARTY_NAME = oSHORT_NAME,
		COUNTERPARTY_TYPE = oTRADE_COUNTERPARTY,
		TRADER_NAME = oTRADER_NAME,
		Internal = {o INTERNAL},
		TrueAmendment,
		TrueCancelCorrect,
		GaapRelief_Exist,
		BOOK_NAME = Book_Name,
		USER_NAME = oUser_Nme,
		CHANGE_DATE = Business_Date_Rpt,
		TRADE_STATUS = oTrade_Status,
		DESK_NAME = sDeskName,
		COUNTERPARTY_LONGNAME = oLONG_NAME,
		PRODUCT_TYPE = oPRODUCT_TYPE,
		MODIF_DATE = new_modif_date,
		SALES_PERSON = oSALES_PERSON,
		TRADING_UNIT_NAME = {o TRADING_UNIT_NAME},
		EconomicChange_Exist,
		TRADE_ID = oCalypso_Reference),
	partitionFileNames:[($toKriKpiTotalActivity_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> toKriKpiTotalActivity
